title: A/R Detail: opening an invoice link in a new tab asks there
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations: your current location and your other location.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a customer with an open work order invoice A made at your other location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with that customer ticked and every bucket expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Right-click invoice A's number.
  2. Choose "Open link in new tab".
  3. Switch to the new tab.
  4. Switch back to the report's tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The browser's menu for the link opens.

Step 2:

  • A new tab opens.
  • The report's tab shows no dialog.

Step 3:

  • The document page shows and asks to switch location itself.

Step 4:

  • The report is unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
